# African Journals Online (AJOL)

> AJOL is Africa's premier open-access platform for indexing and discovering peer-reviewed scholarly journals across all academic disciplines.

AJOL aggregates African research publications across sciences, humanities, social sciences, and professional fields, making African scholarship globally accessible. The platform uses Dewey Decimal Classification to organize journals by subject area, serving researchers, institutions, and the broader Global South academic community.

## Core Platform

- [African Journals Online](https://www.ajol.info): AJOL main site - open-access African scholarly journal indexing platform
- [African Journals Online](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol): AJOL homepage - premier open-access African scholarly journal platform

## Browse Journals by Category

- [Titles by Category](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category): Browse AJOL journals by Dewey Decimal Classification categories
- [African Studies](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-african-studies): AJOL African Studies journals directory with peer-reviewed publications
- [Health & Medicine](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-health): AJOL health and medical research peer-reviewed journals
- [Biology & Life Sciences](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-biology-and-life-sciences): AJOL biology, life sciences and medical research journal directory
- [Agriculture & Food Sciences](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-agriculture-and-food-sciences): AJOL agriculture and food science journals including crop science
- [Environmental Sciences](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-environmental-sciences): AJOL environmental sciences and habitat journals from Africa

## Science & Engineering Journals

- [Chemistry, Mathematics & Physics](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-chemistry-mathematics-and-physics): AJOL chemistry, mathematics, physics and engineering journals
- [Earth Sciences](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-earth-sciences): AJOL earth sciences, geography and environmental technology journals
- [Aquatic Sciences](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-aquatic-sciences): AJOL aquatic and marine science journals with peer-reviewed content
- [Fish & Fisheries](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-fish-and-fisheries): AJOL marine science and fisheries journals from Africa

## Social Sciences & Professional Fields

- [Economics & Development](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-economics-and-development): AJOL economics and development peer-reviewed journal collection
- [Finance & Management](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-finance-and-management): AJOL finance, management and business journals directory
- [Education](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-education): AJOL education and chemistry education journals from African publishers

## Arts, Humanities & History

- [Humanities](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-humanities): AJOL humanities and multidisciplinary African journal directory
- [History](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-history): AJOL history and African research journal collection
- [Art & Architecture](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-art-and-architecture): AJOL art and architecture journals from African institutions

## Multidisciplinary Collections

- [General Science](https://www.ajol.info/index.php/ajol/browseBy/category-general-science): AJOL multidisciplinary general science journals directory
